name: Image Scale Scroller
description: Pinned split section where a counter counts up and the heading shifts color while a full-bleed image slides to the right and scales down, revealing bordered boxes. Stacks on mobile.
contents: Topline label, counting number with unit, heading second line and body paragraph
Full-bleed image that slides and scales during the pin
Divider line and bordered reveal boxes on desktop
behavior: Section pins while a scrubbed timeline counts the number up and changes the heading color
Desktop image slides to the right half and scales down while boxes scale in
Below the mobile breakpoint the text stacks above the image, boxes are hidden and the image only scales
